description: Without --project-dir the CLI's project is the git top level of its cwd (k43): from a subdirectory of a git project the sync installs at the top level, none in the subdirectory; from a subdirectory of a home that is itself a checkout (dotfiles) the project is the home, so there is no project scope. The home's checkout puts ~/.claude in a work tree: the user scope writes its .gitignore block.
